svg.aria-label: Where the ROI axis collapses — tube and line, at one scale
svg.title: Where the ROI axis collapses — tube and line, at one scale
svg.desc: Both panels are draughtsman figures of a traced model, placed at 1:1: one mark is one ROI in either column. tube takes its mean in the third box, before a kernel has run. line smears and votes per ROI first, so the column of marks survives to the fourth. After each mean there is no ROI axis in the tensor, and nothing is drawn for one.
svg.text: Where the ROI axis collapses — tube and line, at one scale
